codec: fish-speech S2 semantic codebook (cb0, vocab 4096) — fish_codec.pth == fishaudio/s1-mini codec.pth (ledger S35)
what: cb0 codes that encode SILENCE / PAUSE / CLOSURE frames. Ground truth uses them on 6.8% of frames (94% utterance-interior), and on B-ft-rendered GT those frames are 42 dB quieter than the rest (median -69.6 vs -27.6 dB RMS). GT never emits more than 9 of them in a row (n=498 runs / 99 rows; p99 = 7).
derived: 2026-09-04, ledger S200. 'attractor' = top-20 codes in the two user-confirmed silent clips (00__2c2 after 'do', 11__3pureC3), covering 89% of their frames; 'gt_edge' = the codes GT emits in its first/last 3 frames. The union is the guard's mask set. Extra members are harmless: no code in real speech runs past the budget.
